 ONE Friday Fights 178 & The Inner Circle 38 Live Stream and Results
 Events ONE Championship Results & Recaps 
 Staff 
 November 13, 2026 
 ONE Championship was in action at the Lumpinee Stadium on Friday the 13th for ONE Friday Fights 178 and The Inner Circle 38.
 The flyweight Muay Thai Grand Prix quarterfinals kicked off at the event, with Rodtang Jitmuangnon taking on Nong-O Hama in a battle of ex-champs.
 Where to Watch ONE Championship
 ONE Friday Fights 178 takes place on Friday, November 13, 2026 at the Lumpinee Stadium in Bangkok, Thailand. Inner Circle fights are available via the  ONE Championship website , while the main card streams live on Youtube for western fight fans. Full results from the event can be found below; the action gets underway at 7:30AM ET, 4:30AM PT. 
 ONE Friday Fights 178 Results
 Cihan Dogu defeats Pek Por Tor Tor Thongtawee via unanimous decision – Muay Thai 
 Anar “Atilla” Mammadov defeats Superlek Jitmuangnon via knockout at 2:08 of round one – Muay Thai 
 Kyaw Swar Win defeats Sherzodi “Sher” Sadullo via unanimous decision – Muay Thai 
 Ali Al-Kinani defeats Kumanngern Jitmuangnon via knockout at 1:24 of round two – Muay Thai 
 “Champ” Natakorn Kesorn defeats Mathew “Quick” Gesto via split decision – MMA 
 Superchamp Wutdychonburipraleasing defeats Superjeng Sor Rungsak via knockout at 1:57 of round one – Muay Thai 
 Suhyeon “Iron” Kim defeats Takumi Fukamachi via split decision – MMA 
 Nongnuk Sor Dechapan defeats Giorgia “Italian Psycho” Pieropan via unanimous decision – Muay Thai 
 Shimon Yoshinari defeats Ramadan “The Scorpion” Ondash via unanimous decision – Muay Thai 
 The Inner Circle 
 Nong-O Hama defeats Rodtang “The Iron Man” Jitmuangnon via unanimous decision – Muay Thai 
 PTT Apichart Farm defeats Hamza Rachid via knockout at 2:37 of round one – Muay Thai 
 Lenny Blasi defeats Adam “El Capitano” Benwarwar via unanimous decision – Muay Thai 
 Songpandin Chor Kaewwiset defeats Petubon Sor Teanchai via split decision – Muay Thai 
 Banluelok Sitwatcharachai defeats Mya Lone Chaw via knockout at 1:04 of round two – Muay Thai
